BEHIND THE NUMBERS

How the estimate works

We start with your monthly budget, then adjust each bucket for relative city prices. These are planning estimates, not quotes.

Your spending × destination index ÷ current city indexCalculated separately for each spending bucket.

What changes?

  • Rent: uses the city’s rent index, adjusted for your current and future housing choices. An actual rent you enter replaces this calculation.
  • Groceries and dining: use their own category price indices.
  • Transportation, utilities, shopping, and fun: use the overall cost-of-living index as a rough proxy. This assumes you keep the same habits and transport mode.
  • Subscriptions & other: stay at the amount you enter. This bucket can also hold insurance, debt payments, and other costs you prefer to keep fixed.

Roommates assumption

Shared housing starts at 65% of solo rent per person. This is a planning assumption, not a measured city statistic. It also adjusts your baseline if you currently share housing.

65%

Sources & limits

Numbeo’s 2026 North America city indices provide the rent, grocery, restaurant, and general price comparisons. Read how these indices work. This is a fixed snapshot, not a live feed.

Shown ranges are ±15% scenario bands, not statistical confidence intervals. They illustrate price variation, but do not cover every possibility. Taxes, income changes, moving costs, and neighborhood-level prices are not calculated. Review actual rent and transport costs before making a move.
